introHtml: LMRK badge ID holders offer a reliable way to keep employee IDs, visitor passes, and trade show credentials visible and protected. These holders feature clear vinyl pouches that resist wear, with options like hang holes, bulldog clips, or integrated lanyards for easy attachment. For bulk buyers, LMRK provides consistent quality across vinyl badge pouches, nylon neck wallets, and easy-slide designs. Whether you need basic ID holders or full-color custom badges, LMRK delivers durable solutions that keep identification secure during daily use or special events.
